thread:
Alex: quick check-in: I flipped the per-route v2 preference for tenant:solace but console still shows v1 as the "preferred" badge. Route traces show request header asked v2, routing chose v2, but execution fell back to v1 due to kv-cache planning. Console copy is misleading.
Sam: thanks for flagging. can you paste the trace header? worth confirming `x-rw-requested-variant` vs `x-rw-effective-variant`.
Alex: trace snippet: `x-rw-requested-variant: model-redwood-v2` / `x-rw-effective-variant: model-redwood-v1` / fallback_reason: `kv-cache-mismatch`.
Nina: that's the root cause: we only surface config preference in the console (what was set), not the effective routed variant (what actually executed). UX should show both and the fallback reason.
Beth: From support side, tenant sees "You're on v2" in console but calls are failing or slower; they get confused. We need a compact representation: "Config / Effective / Last 50 requests" and a tooltip explaining billing semantics.
Sam: on billing: current billing attributes to executed variant (v1). That makes tenant facing metrics drop when they request v2. I propose we bill quota units to the requested model tag (so tenant's quotas reflect what they intended) and bill infra cost to executed variant for internal cost accounting.
Alex: that split makes sense for customer-facing quota but requires two telemetry fields: `requested_model_tag` and `executed_model_tag`, plus `fallback_flag=true` when mismatch. Sampling at 1% initially for high-volume tenants until we validate.
Nina: we also need to surface a small "sticky delay" indicator. There's often a 10-40s window where console flags flip but routing still has pinned state. A subtle orange badge like "pending effective" when config != effective for >10s.
Beth: good visual. Also add a dashboard tile "Top tenants by fallback-rate (24h)" to prioritize fixes.
Sam: I'll add metrics: counter fallback_count{tenant, requested, executed, reason} and histogram fall_latency_seconds to measure time-to-effect after config change. Also nightly reconcile job: compare consumed-quota (requested attribution) vs executed infra usage and emit alerts if variance >10%.
Alex: we should codify precedence in the spec: 1) token header variant if present, 2) tenant-level override, 3) route default, 4) global default. Ambiguity there caused a bad rollout last month.
Nina: agree. Also request that fallback_reason be an enum: `kv-cache-mismatch`, `model-unavailable`, `capacity-pressure`, `seqlen-exceeded`, `incompatible-quant`. Include sequence_length_hint when reason == `seqlen-exceeded` or `kv-cache-mismatch`.
Sam: PR plan: telemetry fields + counters + reconcile job. I'll add a 1% sampling toggle per route and wire logs to a short-lived sample stream.
Beth: I'll design the console mock showing both requested/effective tags, fallback_reason inline, and the orange "pending effective" badge. Will add copy about billing attribution: "Quota is charged to requested model; infra costs attributed to executed model." Need legal/finance signoff.
Devops-bot: CI: patch/eng-platform/route-effective-telemetry (PR 3182) passed tests and is queued for staging deploy.
Alex: action items recap: Alex -> spec doc + precedence table; Sam -> metrics + sampling + reconcile job; Nina -> UX badge behavior; Beth -> console mock + billing copy; Sam/Beth -> coordinate with finance for quota semantics.
Nina: small ask: add console query that lists tenants with >1% fallback-rate in the last 24h and a quick link to trace samples. That will make oncall triage much faster.
Sam: done. I'll add the query and a Grafana tile under the deprec-dashboard team.
Alex: ok I'll open the console PR and link to Sam's metrics PR and Beth/Nina mocks. We'll enable 1% sampling on the route group now.
Beth: please tag me on PRs so I can update copy and ensure the tooltip matches design.
Devops-bot: scheduled: deploy patch/eng-platform/route-effective-telemetry -> staging in 3m.
